name: rating
title: Rating
summary: A score out of a few stars, which can be set or only shown.
description: A score out of a few stars, optionally in halves. Hovering previews the score, a click sets it; it can also only show a score (readOnly). Stars are filled in ink over line-strong ones (md 24px cells with 20px stars, sm 18px with 14px: the switch's heights). It is a radio group: one tab stop, arrow keys change the score. Behaviour by Ark UI's rating-group (Zag). Controlled or uncontrolled.

anatomy.description: Ark's rating-group root: a column, the label above the stars. Half opacity and inert when disabled.
Visible name (the label prop): text.sm, medium, ink, as the Field's label; it names the group.
role=radiogroup: the stars side by side, no gap of their own (the cell is larger than its star).

One star, role=radio named "3 stars". Two Phosphor stars (fill) in one cell: the empty one in color.line-strong, the filled one in color.ink over it, shown when the engine highlights the item (data-highlighted: within the score, or within the hover preview) and cut to its inline-start half for a half star (data-half). md 24px / 20px star, sm 18px / 14px; radius.chip for the focus ring. On a coarse pointer the hit area is 40px high.
Ark's hidden input with the score, for a form (name).

value.description: The score: 0 for none, up to count; in halves with allowHalf.

allowHalf.description: The first half of a star picks .5 (the inline-start half, mirrored right-to-left).

size.description: md: 24px cells, 20px stars. sm: 18px cells, 14px stars.

readOnly.description: Shows the score; it cannot change. The checked star stays focusable, so the score is announced.

events.valueChange: (value: number) after a click or a key

keyboard: Tab moves to the checked star (one tab stop)
Arrow Right / Arrow Up: one more (a half with allowHalf); Arrow Left / Arrow Down: one less (mirrored right-to-left)
Home / End: the lowest / the highest score
Space: sets the score to the focused star
notes: Each star is role=radio with aria-roledescription "rating", named "<n> stars", aria-checked on the score's star.
Name the group with label (visible) or aria-label.
Read-only: the checked star stays in the tab order and the score is read; nothing changes it.
To set it from outside, control `value`: React value / onValueChange.

motion: fill (pointer only): opacity over duration.fast as the hover preview or the score changes; instant from the keyboard (kbd-instant)
press (pointer only): the star gives to motion.press-scale-sm over duration.press with easing.out-strong; not when read-only
